Name: Tree with Birds
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[center][b][color=#ff00ff][size=5]On sunny days, birds will visit the trees and bring Fairy Roses.
On rainy days...?[/size][/color][/b][/center]

[size=2]Each tree only takes up a 1x1 tile, making it easy to incorporate into your farm layout.

The birds are animated.[/size]

Construction is locked at the start of the game.
The unlock requirements are...
[spoiler]
[list]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=3]Reach 3 hearts of friendship with Robin.[/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#ffff00][size=3]Repair the bus to the Desert.[/size][/color][/*]
[/list]Once both conditions are met, you will receive a letter from Robin.
After reading it, the trees will become available in Robin's construction menu.[/spoiler]

[color=#ffff00][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size][/color]
[size=2]If you interact with a tree for the first time that day while your inventory is full, a message will be displayed, but you will not receive the item.[/size]


Currently, English and Japanese translation files are included.
